name.zh: Pluricarpellatia 早期水生被子植物

description.en: Rooted shallow freshwater Pluricarpellatia-inspired herb with horizontal rhizome, visible petiole bases and simple cordate to peltate leaves. No modern waterlily flower or unassociated reproductive organs.
description.zh: 有根浅淡水Pluricarpellatia启发草本，具水平根茎、可见柄基和简单心形至盾形叶。不加现代睡莲大花或未关联繁殖器官。
